about: Rows cmux adds to the shared regex-after-token table (regex-after-token.json, pinned in regex-after-token.json.pin), in its row form: the cases from the review of manaflow-ai/cmux#41341 (F1: a keyword is a whole name; F3: /> is a JSX tag only inside a JSX open tag; a } is a block's or an object's by the token before its {). Sent to manaflow-ai/cmux-platform#1271 for its table too.

rows.why: review of manaflow-ai/cmux#41341, F1: πif is one name, not the keyword if after π; after the ) of its call, a / divides
#if is a private name, not the keyword if: after the ) of its call, a / divides
a keyword after ?. is a property name
πreturn is one name, not the keyword return: a / divides
review of manaflow-ai/cmux#41341, F3: /> is a self-closing JSX tag only inside a JSX open tag; after the } of a block it starts a regex
inside a JSX open tag, the / after an attribute's or a spread's } closes the tag
after the } of a switch block, a / starts a regex
after the } of a finally block, a / starts a regex
after the } of an else block, a / starts a regex
after the } of an object literal that follows =, a / divides
after the } of an object literal that follows return, a / divides
after the } of an object literal that follows (, a / divides
